verdict.rationale: Retell has a dedicated concurrency page that documents a default quota of 20 concurrent calls for Pay-As-You-Go workspaces and a reserved inbound concurrency setting that caps outbound calls. The analytics dashboard also tracks concurrency. However, nothing in the pack shows how to raise the quota self-serve, so scaling to many simultaneous calls without asking for capacity is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented self-serve or automatic way to raise the concurrency limit beyond the default, documented upper scale limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of high-concurrency operation.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging

citations.quote: Pay-As-You-Go workspaces are allocated a quota of 20 concurrent calls by default.
When `reserved_inbound_concurrency` is configured, outbound calls can use at most your concurrency limit minus the reserved amount.
